summary: Red Violet, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of common stock. The company sold 1,916,667 shares (including full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option) at $60.00 per share, raising approximately $108.6 million net. Proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes, including potential strategic acquisitions. This is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. The filing includes customary underwriting terms and legal opinion; no change of control, restructuring, or strategic review is indicated.
